selection: Maximize dev Evidence Hit@3, then dev Hit@1, then minimize chunks. Break remaining ties in A/B/C order. Record selection before issuing test queries.
coherence_sample: Sort source unit IDs, take every third entry (starting at index zero), and select the first chunk covering offset 0 from each selected unit for each strategy.
history: The initial 5 test questions were exposed during the first review. This run uses 5 new questions t01–t05 from the test documents. No test output from these questions was used to choose model, chunk settings, filters or the selection rule.
